lead.purpose: Purpose line under a display or headline.

label.purpose: Printed field labels, legends, column heads, form footers; uppercase. Never a kicker.

hand.purpose: Written entries: grid values, load chips, notches.

hand-display.purpose: A single large written value (stepper load).

note.purpose: Short handwritten aside under a control.

row-head.purpose: Exercise names heading a grid row; phone body size.

small.purpose: Small print under grids and in the notch table.

hand-aside.purpose: Written line under a large value; ruled fields.

depth.name: card-overlap
depth.purpose: The only depth: each card covers the edge of the previous one.

depth.name: card-settle
depth.value: translate 0 48px to 0, animation-timeline view(), range entry 0% to entry 55%, inside @supports
depth.purpose: Cards rise into their overlapping place on scroll.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: Ink writing in, plates sliding on, stamps landing.

motion.name: ease-trace
motion.purpose: Traced loops, strikes and drawn lines.

motion.name: intro
motion.value: ticks clip 350ms at 150ms + 110ms each; rows from 600ms at 110ms per row + 45ms per cell; loops from 1000ms; class removed at 2600ms
motion.purpose: Arrival: ticks trace, then the grid writes row by row.

motion.name: write-row
motion.value: clip-path inset(-12px 100% -12px -12px) to inset(-12px) 700ms, 70ms per row, 45ms per cell
motion.purpose: Changed grid rows write in left to right.

motion.name: hand-loop
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 over 600ms, pathLength 1, row delay + 380ms
motion.purpose: Change-red loop traced around a progressing value.

motion.name: plate-slide
motion.value: translateX(±70px) + opacity, in 450ms ease-ink, out 300ms ease-plate-out
motion.purpose: Plates slide on and off the sleeve on + / −.

motion.name: strike-rewrite
motion.value: 3px change-red line scaleX 0 to 1 from left, 350ms ease-trace; row rewritten after 520ms
motion.purpose: A refused notch struck through, then rewritten.

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: opacity 0 + rotate(-7deg) scale(1.15) to rotate(-7deg) scale(1), 400ms ease-ink; closing stamp +300ms on view

motion.name: ink-on-view
motion.value: [data-in].in .ink stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0, 1.4s ease-trace, per-path --d delay, IntersectionObserver threshold .4
motion.purpose: Drawn lines trace once on view.

motion.name: typing
motion.value: one letter every 40ms after 200ms, on view
motion.purpose: TV address written letter by letter.

motion.name: tv-clock
motion.value: arc stroke-dashoffset 1s linear, one tick per second, at most 5 ticks per viewing (threshold .5), never loops
motion.purpose: Live rest clock over the TV capture.

motion.name: row-hold
motion.purpose: One row held at a time on hover/focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.motion set only without prefers-reduced-motion; animation and transition none under reduce
motion.purpose: All motion gated and off under reduced motion.

components.description: The workout card: printed heads, marker entries, circled progress, barred impossible row.
components.css: :host{--rack:#1c1c1e;--orange:#f3a26e;--white:#eef0f2;--blue:#a9cbe8;--ink:#141414;--marker:#1b3aa8;--change:#8a0f0a;--steel:#8b8f96;--print:"Archivo","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;--hand:"Kalam","Bradley Hand",cursive} .ds-grid{border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--orange);font-family:var(--print)} .ds-grid th,.ds-grid td{border:1.5px solid var(--ink);padding:8px 12px;text-align:left} .ds-grid thead th{font:700 .75rem/1.15 var(--print);font-stretch:80%;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase} .ds-grid tbody th{font-weight:600} .ds-grid td{font:700 1.1875rem/1.1 var(--hand);color:var(--marker);white-space:nowrap} .ds-grid td.up{color:var(--change)} .ds-grid td.up span{display:inline-block;padding:0 .3em;border:2px solid var(--change);border-radius:50% 46% 52% 44%/56% 50% 48% 52%} .ds-grid tr.none td{background:linear-gradient(to top right,transparent calc(50% - 1px),var(--ink) calc(50% - .5px),var(--ink) calc(50% + .5px),transparent calc(50% + 1px))} .ds-grid tr.none th{color:#4a2a17} .ds-grid tbody tr{transition:opacity .2s} .ds-grid tbody:hover tr:not(:hover){opacity:.4}

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a printed gym workout card, filled in by hand, filed in a charcoal card rack. The card stock carries everything: a black printed grid, condensed printed headings and field labels, and entries written in blue marker. The page does not decorate the card; it is the card. Content that the program writes (loads, reps, verdicts, ticks) is handwritten; the frame that holds it (headings, column heads, labels, rules) is printed.

The system is flat and dense like a real form: hard 1.5 to 2px black rules, square corners, generous card padding, and no shading of any kind. Depth exists only because one card physically overlaps the edge of the previous one. Colour is rationed: the stocks are pale and quiet, the ink is black, the marker is blue, and a single dark red is reserved for whatever progresses.

Motion is ink and paper, not interface. Ink writes: on arrival the ticks are traced, then the grid writes itself row by row; changed entries write in from left to right, a progressing value is circled by a hand loop, a refused notch is struck through then rewritten, the TV address is written letter by letter, and drawn lines (chart, padlock) trace themselves when they come into view. Objects move the way they would on the bench: plates slide on and off the sleeve, a rubber stamp lands, cards settle onto the stack as they scroll in, and the TV capture's rest clock ticks for five seconds per viewing and stops. One row is held at a time while the rest dim. Nothing floats, bounces or loops. All motion sits behind a `motion` class set only when `prefers-reduced-motion` does not ask for less, and every animation and transition is off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal rack ground with square card stocks in orange, bristol white and pale blue, stacked by overlap.
Two hands: condensed Archivo for everything printed, Kalam marker for everything written.
One change colour, used only on what progresses, lightens or breaks a record.
Black printed grids and boxes as the main structure; impossible values shown as barred empty cells.
A perforated filing hole punched at the top centre of every card.

rules.name: The One Change Colour Rule
rules.body: Progress Red marks change and nothing else. If an element is red, the reader must be able to say what progressed, lightened or broke. A screen with no change shows no red.

rules.name: The Stock Is The Surface Rule
rules.body: Every content surface is one of the three card stocks on the rack. No fourth stock, no tinted panels inside a card; inside a card, structure comes from black rules and boxes.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Printed means the form; handwritten means the data. Headings, labels and instructions are Archivo; values the program or the user writes are Kalam in Blue Marker. Never set a heading in Kalam or a written value in Archivo.

rules.name: The Field Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase printed labels name a field, a box or a column, the way a printed form does. They never sit above a headline as a kicker; the printed form footer that names each card closes the card at the bottom.

rules.name: The Overlap Only Rule
rules.body: Something is above something else only because it overlaps it. If a layer needs a shadow to read as raised, it is the wrong layer.

dos: Do put every content surface on one of the three card stocks, stacked by an 18px overlap with alternating inset.
Do write data in Kalam Blue Marker and print structure in condensed Archivo (width 68% headings, 80% labels, 92% body).
Do reserve Progress Red for what progressed, lightened or changed; circle it by hand in grids.
Do show what cannot be done as a barred empty cell, not as a disabled grey control or a hidden row.
Do keep borders black and square: 1.5px for grid lines, 2px for boxes and controls.
Do use each stock's own muted ink for small print on that stock.

Do keep motion to ink (clip write-in, traced loops, strikes and lines, letter-by-letter writing), physical objects (plates on the sleeve, stamps landing, cards settling 48px onto the stack, a clock ticking at most 5 s per viewing) and row holding; gate it behind the motion class and disable it under reduced motion.
Do close every feature card with its printed form footer.
Do credit third-party images and their licence in the caption.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, blur, glows or shading gradients; hard-stop gradients are only for drawing lines (bars, staples).
Don't round card, box or control corners; round only real round things (hole, phone screens, app mark, the hand-drawn circle).
Don't use Progress Red, or any extra hue, for emphasis, headings, links or buttons.
Don't put an uppercase printed label above a headline as a kicker; printed caps label fields only.
Don't set headings in Kalam or values in Archivo.
Don't tilt or float product screens in a device mockup; they are stapled flat onto a card.
Don't loop, float or bounce anything; every motion plays once per trigger and stops.
Don't use the borrowed app colours (app plate red, app white) outside the app mark and the TV capture overlay.
